dogecoin.text:
@dogecoin_rise I get that you want this to be true but you're just pulling numbers out of your ass and it's irresponsible as fuck.

It's gonna be decades for this to be 10 dollars, if ever.  Anyone with a basic understand of market capitalization understands this.

Real talk:  Starbucks will never accept $DOGE because of the wild price fluctuations.

Paying DOGE for a drink and then 24 hours later having some whale liquidate his portfolio and the coin losing 50% of its value will never fly in a retail setting.
